subtitle: A workbook Finance can manipulate themselves

code:
SELECT f.SalesOrderID, d.FullDate AS OrderDate,
       p.ProductName, p.CategoryName,
       t.TerritoryName,
       f.OrderQty, f.LineTotal
FROM dw.FactProductSales f
JOIN dw.DimDate d ON f.OrderDateKey = d.DateKey
JOIN dw.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
JOIN dw.DimTerritory t ON f.TerritoryKey = t.TerritoryKey;
caption: Real column names, real dates, no surrogate keys exposed.
